name: claw hammer
definition: hammer with a striking face and a curved claw for pulling nails.
notes: Claw hammers sold by Toolstation among club, brick and ball pein hammers.

name: double-faced hammer [genno]
definition: Japanese hammer with two striking faces, one flat and one slightly convex.
notes: Axminster Japanese Hammers page sells Hakkaku Genno, double-faced.

name: mallet
definition: soft-faced or wooden-headed hammer for striking chisels and assemblies.
notes: Rubber, soft-faced and dead blow mallets sold; Narex bench mallet.

name: demolition hammer (breaker)
definition: powered percussion tool that drives a chisel or point by hammer blows only, with no rotation, to break concrete, masonry and tile (jackhammer and pneumatic or petrol breakers are this kind, `drive` an attribute; provisional until a page selling demolition hammers or breakers as a type is fetched; memo section 14).
notes: Makita HM1214C sold as SDS-max demolition hammer; Source Atlantic files Electric Demolition Hammers.

name: wrecking bar
definition: flat or round steel bar with a curved claw end for prying and demolition.
notes: Estwing gooseneck wrecking bar; Tooled-Up Wrecking Bars category.

name: nailer [nail gun]
definition: tool that drives collated nails, powered by air, gas or electric/battery drive.
notes: Toolstation Nailers: framing, brad, finish, pin, concrete; air, gas, cordless.

name: staple gun
definition: tool that fires staples into a surface.
notes: Toolstation lists staplers (Arrow, Stanley) with nailers; fencing and crown staplers.

name: rivet gun
definition: tool that sets rivets.
notes: Stanley MR100 sold as Hand Riveter, fixed head.

name: MIG welder
definition: welding machine that feeds a continuous wire electrode through a gun with shielding gas.
notes: Toolstation MIG incl. gasless; Bigweld MIG Welders category.

name: TIG welder
definition: welding machine using a tungsten electrode and a separate filler rod under shielding gas.
notes: Draper 145A TIG welder; Bigweld TIG Welders category.

name: stick welder
definition: welding machine that burns coated rod electrodes held in a clamp.
notes: Stick/ARC/MMA welders at Toolstation; Bigweld Stick Welders category.

name: multi-process welder
definition: one welding machine set up to run more than one of the MIG, TIG and stick processes.
notes: Multi-process MIG/ARC/TIG welders; Bigweld says combine MIG, TIG and Stick.

name: soldering iron
definition: hand-held heated tip for melting solder, usually in electrical and electronics work.
notes: Soldering irons with stand and cordless M12 iron sold.

name: soldering station
definition: temperature-controlled power base with a soldering iron handpiece and stand.
notes: Draper soldering station; Hakko FX-888DX digital station with iron.

name: glue gun
definition: hand-held electric tool that melts and dispenses adhesive sticks.
notes: Glue guns listed separately from heat guns.

name: heat gun
definition: hand-held electric hot-air tool for stripping, shrinking and softening.
notes: Heat guns listed separately from glue guns.

name: pliers
definition: hand tool with two pivoted jaws to grip, bend or cut.
notes: Toolstation pliers: long nose, combination, locking, cutting, water pump.

name: clamp
definition: tool that presses and holds workpieces together by a screw, bar or lever.
notes: F, parallel jaw and quick lever clamps; bar clamps.

name: bench vise
definition: jaws fixed to a bench that hold a workpiece.
notes: Woodworking vices: front, inset, carpenter vices; engineers vices not seen.

name: workbench
definition: work surface made for tool work, with or without vises, dog holes and storage.
notes: Work benches sold as a type; Axminster bench with two vices.

name: sawhorse
definition: trestle-type support pair or single frame carrying a workpiece at working height.
notes: Saw Horses category with pairs and twin packs.

name: trestle
definition: frame support for a board or workpiece, used in pairs.
notes: Trestles shared category with workbenches; Minotaur Builders Trestle sold under that name.

name: tape measure
definition: coiled flexible rule in a case.
notes: Tape measures 5m to 100m sold in Levels, Measuring & Detection.

name: spirit level
definition: straight body with liquid vials showing level or plumb.
notes: Box beam, torpedo and I-beam spirit levels.

name: laser distance measurer
definition: handheld device that measures distance with a laser, for building and trade work.
notes: DeWalt laser distance measurers 16m and 30m.

name: caliper
definition: sliding gauge measuring outside, inside and depth dimensions.
notes: Digital, vernier, dial, depth calipers.

name: micrometer
definition: screw gauge for precise outside, inside or depth measurement.
notes: External, depth, internal micrometers.

name: dial indicator
definition: gauge with a plunger or lever and a dial showing small displacement.
notes: Analogue, digital and lever-type dial indicators.

name: height gauge
definition: gauge on a base for measuring or marking height.
notes: Mitutoyo Series 570 height gages; scribing and motorised types.

name: hardness tester
definition: instrument that tests the hardness of a material.
notes: Portable Leeb hardness tester HN-D sold; MQS lists hardness under Material Testing.

name: coordinate measuring machine
definition: machine that probes a part to measure its geometry in three axes.
notes: Mitutoyo CRYSTA-APEX EX CNC coordinate measuring machines sold.

name: marking gauge [kebiki]
definition: tool that scribes a line parallel to an edge.
notes: Kebiki Japanese marking gauges sold single and double cutting.

name: square
definition: right-angle tool for marking and checking squareness, including combination squares.
notes: Combination, try and square sets sold.

name: multimeter
definition: instrument that measures several electrical quantities for trade and electronics work.
notes: Fluke digital multimeters; Fluke 117 handheld multimeter sold.
